title: Glowmarkt Gas Usage vs Degree Days

app: Solar inverters (SolarEdge/Enphase/Fronius/Growatt), Tesla Powerwall, smart meters (P1/DSMR, Emporia Vue, Sense) via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:

join hdd [search index=personal sourcetype=ecowitt:obs]
eval kwh_per_hdd=consumption_kwh/hdd
description: Normalizes Glowmarkt gas consumption against heating degree days.
value: Surfacing glowmarkt gas usage vs degree days helps you act before small issues become habits.
implementation: Ingest the relevant home energy & solar export into `index=personal` and schedule this search weekly.
visualization: Table or chart of key fields.
grandmaExplanation: It lays out when glowmarkt gas usage vs degree days matters for your routine.
